title: Personally, I think it turned out pretty well.
author: KometUnit1108
selftext:
**I'd like to hear what you all think of this game.**

It was created almost entirely with AI, and some of the gun models are from TastyTony on Sketchfab under a CC 4.0 license.

The video only shows a small part of it. Among the customers in this game are robbers, as well as police officers who appear toward the end. There are also hitmen. As for the hitmen, they’ll open fire on you immediately after you sell them a gun, so you’ll have to take them out with your self-defense revolver. (The police and robbers are also targets.)

The gameplay involves playing as an illegal arms dealer who keeps providing customers with the guns they want.

There are five “nights,” structured like chapters, and the one shown in the video is the final chapter—the hardest one with the most events. To clear each chapter (night), you must keep selling guns until morning (6:00 AM), survive without getting shot by the police or customers who point guns at you, and avoid being taken out by the boss for failing to meet your sales quota.

There’s also some replay value: once you’ve completed all the chapters, “ENDLESS” mode unlocks—in this mode, dawn never breaks, and the game becomes a challenge to beat your personal best in terms of how much money you can earn.
